loading_sequence: CPU WFI and BIU/accepted MEM transactions idle
Team loader drives original CPU MEM master request fields and response ready
All8168 words traverse original SystemBus to shared SRAM; all write responses drain
DMA rereads all8168 sourcewords through original SystemBus
All12672 result writes and responses complete
CPU reads actual count and lastword then returns

reference_role: Verification oracle only; its raw/q/matrix outputs do not enter CPU task memory or hardware source packets
post_task_SRAM_oracle: After real CPU completion, all writes/ACKs and VCD off, readonly model-pin observation drives CEN/GWEN=read/WEN=allones/A; it never writes SRAM data, supplies task operands or contributes performance activity
